## Change and reason

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and why the change is needed. Link the tracking issue.

## Validation

List commands and results, including skipped test counts and any checks not run with reasons.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/JKamsker/PS5SaveGame-Toolkit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the build and test commands.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant backend, web and e2e tests pass; builds have **0 warnings** (or explain checks not applicable).
- [ ] Sample-dependent tests skip cleanly without private samples; synthetic tests still pass.
- [ ] No save samples, decrypted dumps or extracted sample data are committed.
- [ ] Documentation and confidence/write-scope claims are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Licence, source attribution and required notices are recorded per [plugin guide rule 9](https://github.com/JKamsker/PS5SaveGame-Toolkit/blob/main/docs/PLUGIN_GUIDE.md#hard-rules), or no third-party material was added.
- [ ] Scope rules in [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/JKamsker/PS5SaveGame-Toolkit/blob/main/AGENTS.md) are respected; plugin changes stay in their folder except the allowed central package-version entry. Any out-of-scope follow-ups are recorded separately.
